50 | Shield of Faith | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | F

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can tell the purpose and bonus of any one magical or non-magical
shield.
@@ 2
Caster enchants a shield which is to become his ''Faith’s Shield''.
@@ 3
Caster’s shield DB is improved by +5.
@@ 4
Allows the caster to use his shield to automatically intercept an attack made
against him. The caster must be aware of the attack and it may not be from
behind. Any resulting critical hit will be reduced by one level of severity
(an ‘A’ critical becomes an ‘A’ with a special modification of -25).
@@ 5
Caster is able to determine the exact abilities, properties, powers and
history of any one shield.
@@ 6
Causes holy fires to dance around caster’s shield. Any critical taken in melee
combat causes the attacker to make an RR. Failure results in the attacker
taking a Holy Spell critical one level lower in severity to the one inflicted
on the caster (an ‘A’ critical becomes an ‘A’ with a special modification of
-25).
@@ 7
As Shield Definse 1, except the bonus is +10.
@@ 8
Caster’s missile parry DB bonuses (see RMFRP Section A-10.3) performed while
the caster is holding his shield are increased by 50% for the duration.
@@ 9
Caster’s Faiths Shield will return through the air to the caster’s hand at the
rate of 100 feet per round with no acceleration. If the shield is restrained,
it cannot break free.
@@ 10
As Shield Block I, except the critical is reduced two degrees (a ‘B’ critical
becomes an ‘A’ with a special modification of -25, an ‘A critical becomes an
‘A’ with a special modification of -50).
@@ 11
Caster has all ''must parry'', ''stun'', and ''stun no parry'' critical result
times halved (round down).
@@ 12
As Shield Defense I, except the bonus is +15.
@@ 13
Caster gains +20 to all RRs and DB against frontal spell attacks.
@@ 14
Caster’s shield gains a special bonus of +100 to all breakage checks.
@@ 15
Caster’s DB from any spell parries (see Of Channeling Section 2.9) performed
while the caster is holding his shield are increased by 50%.
@@ 16
As Blessed Shield, except it delivers a Holy Spell critical strike one level
of severity greater than the one inflicted on the caster (an ‘E’ critical
becomes an ‘E’ with a special modification of +10).
@@ 17
As Shield Block I, except the critical is reduced three degrees.
@@ 18
As Shield Defense I, except the bonus is +20.
@@ 19
Caster’s melee parry bonuses are increased by 50%.
@@ 20
Returns caster’s shield to his hand, via teleport, from any place up to 1 mile
away per level of the caster.
@@ 25
As Shield Defense Z, except the bonus is +25.
@@ 30
As Shield Block III, except it works on the next three attacks made against
him.
@@ 50
As Awareness Shield, Power Shield, Divine Shield, and Defender Shield.
